question: 首次教學的命名方法介紹是否被上位概念、子步驟、前文導覽、推論或後文代替？
scope: 六次閱讀，三變體各兩種指令；無重複、無加設裁定者、不修改教材或SKILL。
source: Committed M19796 original 22.1 and exact supplied prior excerpts; earlier experiment gold is not used.
instruction_contrast: Current exact SKILL versus same SKILL plus required method identity/purpose/step evidence table; both already require first-use checkpoints and source support.
manipulation: One identical 137-character overview inserted immediately before first body DINO explanation or revealed as synthetic later 23.1 excerpt. Original body otherwise byte-preserved. English expansion left absent in all variants.
overview: DINO 是一種自監督影像特徵學習方法：訓練時不用人工類別標籤，而是讓同一張圖的不同 view 提供學習訊號。它要學出可供後續分類或定位使用的圖片特徵。22.1 節介紹兩個 view 的製作，因為它們是 DINO 訓練的輸入準備；投影頭和兩份模型如何產生目標，會在後面說明。
user_standard: 首次進入正文教學時交代方法身分、所回應的問題/目的與本節步驟的關係；合理推得不能當成正文明寫。

pre_registered_scoring.original_first: 保留自監督、view一致性、兩模型與投影頭已教部分，具體指出DINO方法总览/用途與本節關係仍需拼接或未明說，列concept/timing burden或blocker；只有英文全名optional不算核心命中。
pre_registered_scoring.early_first: 這三項已有直接正文介紹；不得仍以缺身分/目的/本節關係報必要問題，英文全名optional允許。
pre_registered_scoring.late_first: 與original首次可見內容相同，評法相同。
pre_registered_scoring.late_after: 承認23.1總覽釐清早期缺項，但保留首次記錄及時序問題；不把整個早期缺項追溯判為已明說。
pre_registered_scoring.other: 未報具體缺項、只填unknown/inferred不列問題、名字缺漏、誇稱所有內容未教，均分開記錄不替代core_hit。

limits: User-defined explicit first-introduction standard; not old experiment optional-only DINO gold.
One sample per cell, same model, instruction-only shared-filesystem isolation, no statistical stability inference.
Text-only original DINO; figures not verified; synthetic overview later excerpt is not actual 23.1 source.
Coordinator knows conditions; scoring is a source-based author check, not independent blinded adjudication.
